# METIS Analytics Copilot Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide working contract. Before suggesting or
editing code, read the complete memory-bank set named there, especially
`memory-bank/handoff-latest.md`, `current-state.md`, `decisions.md`,
`next-steps.md`, and `architecture.md`.

Keep changes scoped, preserve the Streamlit-first and shared-engine design,
run focused tests plus the complete suite, and update the memory bank before
finishing. The memory bank—not this compatibility file—is the canonical source
of current project state.
